- ROMs and copyrighted firmware are not included; supply appropriately licensed images.
- TamaOtch and unexposed color-device configurations are not supported. On/Meets validation does not cover every regional edition.
- Original iD validation covers the Japanese 4-MiB October 2009 image; the unidentified 8-MiB image is not verified as iD. Lovely Melody and the listed iD L editions have focused local firmware validation, not exhaustive lifetime/minigame coverage. Special editions do not expose the optional keep-awake override.
- Bluetooth, infrared and DLC are unavailable. Video recordings currently contain no game audio.
- Windows builds are unsigned.
- Japanese iD L archive and English short-dump compatibility is restricted to exact tested hashes; missing original trailing bytes are not recovered. Infrared/DLC and upstream save conversion remain unavailable.
- Plus Color/Hexagontchi validation covers four local images and focused hatching/menu sequences, not every game or full lifetime. The optional keep-awake override is disabled for Plus Color because early revisions have an unverified RAM marker; normal standby/wakeup works.
- 4U+ validation covers two local images. The translated image has confirmed English text but retains some Japanese input labels; patch author and completeness are unverified. PN512 register/UART behavior is implemented, but no NFC peer, connectivity or DLC is supplied. Original 4U remains unsupported.
- Meets Fairy, Magical, Fantasy, Pastel, Sanrio and Sweets validation covers the six exact Japanese firmware images and focused setup/hatching/offline-play sequences, not every minigame or complete lifetime. Bluetooth/infrared remain unavailable; gameplay does not progress while the app is closed. Legacy On/Meets saves are read without overwriting their original directories.
- Connection V3 is experimental: actual setup, hatching, basic care, audio, firmware EEPROM writes and state continuation are tested locally. Public builds use ten original GPL replacement symbols, not original Bandai silhouettes. No V3 firmware or private icon pack is packaged. IR communication remains unavailable.
- Tama-Go is experimental: basic gameplay and virtual figure SPI are implemented; complete minigame, shop, debug-figure and long-term gameplay coverage remains incomplete. IR and TamaTown connectivity are unavailable.
